nodes.label: NixOS module README
nodes.content: The NixOS README catalogs independent feature leaves, compatibility aggregates, package overrides, deploy-rs, and Sanctum service composition.

nodes.label: Compatibility aggregate module
nodes.content: Aggregates such as base, general, desktop, deploy-rs, and sanctum preserve convenient compositions while leaf membership remains explicit.

nodes.label: Explicit Sanctum service membership
nodes.content: Sanctum service leaves import shared core and are explicitly listed in the sanctum aggregate; adding a module cannot silently enable a production service.

nodes.label: Independent deploy-rs roles
nodes.content: Deploy-rs is split into server and initiator features; the initiator installs the client, while activation and passwordless privileges are separately controlled.

edges.evidence: The module catalog identifies base, general, desktop, deploy-rs, and sanctum as compatibility aggregates.
The Sanctum section requires explicit service-leaf membership and limits SOPS imports to secret-using leaves.
The deploy-rs section separates server and initiator features and keeps passwordless activation opt-in.

hyperedges.evidence: The module catalog connects independent leaves, compatibility aggregates, explicit hosts, split deploy-rs roles, explicit Sanctum services, and the supported host set.
